messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

function.name: movie_details_brief
function.description: This function retrieves a brief about a specified movie. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

extra_info.description: Option to get additional information like Director, Cast, Awards etc.

message.reasoning:
We need to use the function movie_details_brief. The user wants brief about "全面啟動" (Inception). Then retrieve extra info for Inception and also for "黑暗騎士" (The Dark Knight). So we need to call function twice? Actually we can call function with title "全面啟動" and extra_info true. That will give brief plus extra info. But they want brief first then extra info. We could call twice: first with extra_info false, then with true. But maybe we can just call once with extra_info true and provide both brief and extra info. But the user explicitly says "簡介" then "再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息". So we need to provide brief, then extra info for Inception, then extra info for The Dark Knight. So we need two calls: one for Inception with extra_info true, one for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. But we also need brief for Inception. We could call Inception twice: first with extra_info false, second with true. Or we could call Inception once with true and extract brief from it. But the function returns brief and extra info. The spec: "This function retrieves a brief about a specified movie. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax." It says "brief about a specified movie". The function signature: movie_details_brief(title: string, extra_info?: boolean). So if extra_info true, it returns brief plus extra info. So we can call Inception with extra_info true and get both. Then we can call The Dark Knight with extra_info true. That satisfies all. So we need to call function twice.

Thus we produce two function calls.
